method: Artifact_tool imported entire original Interior XLSX 5600 rows. NFKD normalized full names; span threshold >=35 years; 3 labels satisfy. Fixed all 3 ranked by span, so no post-hoc sample choice. Institutional official cross-legislature biography sources checked after prereg.

hypothesis_evaluation.H1: NOT_OBSERVED IN FIXED >=35Y sample: no independently certified exact full-name homonym representing different people; do not assert none in overall universe.
hypothesis_evaluation.H0: 3/3 selected long-span names independently supported as positive cross-era person continuities (with birth corroboration).

limits: Samples are older long-serving well-documented politicians by construction, do not estimate false-positive rate or generalize exact name matching to less-documented persons.
Although date of birth and self-listed terms strongly identify, no government-issued globally immutable person ID is present in Interior spreadsheet.
No historical first_public_at independently checked for all members of personal bios; not as-of safe for prediction of each term.
The spelling García-Margallo y Marfil vs García-Margallo Marfil is treated as documented standard convention, not exact canonical string equality without correction.
privacy: Only publicly official professional elected politician profiles cited; no private source rows uploaded.
